ticket.title: search-service is slow and returns errors during the evening peak
ticket.description: Latency and errors rise every evening when traffic is highest. Nothing was released.

logs.message: Cache hit ratio 0.91 for key prefix=catalog

no healthy upstream: all instances saturated

runbooks.title: Slow responses and errors at peak hours
runbooks.content: Possible causes: traffic growth, a slow dependency, noisy neighbours on the node, insufficient capacity, resource limits set too low. Compare CPU and latency with the baseline and check recent configuration changes.

runbooks.title: General HTTP 5xx investigation checklist
runbooks.content: 1. Find the first error in the logs and note the time. 2. Check recent deploys of the affected service near that time. 3. Check dependencies (database, payment gateway, cache). 4. Compare error rate before and after the change.

runbooks.title: Rotating the CDN signing key
runbooks.content: Steps to rotate the CDN signing key every quarter: generate a new key, publish it, wait for propagation, retire the old key.

ground_truth.root_cause: The autoscaler limit for search-service was lowered from 20 to 3 replicas, so it cannot scale out during the evening peak and instances saturate
